subject: Silver Gauntlets
text: After defeating the Iron Knuckle mini-boss as Young Link, a chest containing the Silver Gauntlets is found on the right hand of the Desert Colossus.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: After defeating the Iron Knuckle mini-boss as Young Link, you'll find a 
 chest containing these on the right hand of the Desert Collosus.

subject: Golden Gauntlets
text: The Golden Gauntlets are located in the Shadow trials room of Ganon's Castle.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: In the Shadow trials room in Ganon's Castle. (Spirit Trials in Master
 Quest.)

subject: Heart Container
text: It requires four Heart Pieces to complete one Heart Container.

evidence.quote: It takes four pieces to complete one.

subject: Kokiri's Emerald
text: Kokiri's Emerald is obtained after defeating Queen Gohma inside the Great Deku Tree.

evidence.quote: Gotten: This is gotten after beating Gohma from inside the Great Deku Tree.

subject: Goron's Ruby
text: Goron's Ruby is obtained after clearing Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: Gotten: This can be acquired after clearing Dodongo's Cavern.

subject: Zora's Sapphire
text: Zora's Sapphire is obtained after clearing Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

evidence.quote: Gotten: This is gotten after clearing Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

subject: Light Medallion
text: Link obtains the Light Medallion after drawing the Master Sword from its pedestal for the first time.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: You get this after pulling the Master Sword from its pedestal for the 
 first time.

subject: Forest Medallion
text: The Forest Medallion is obtained after defeating Phantom Ganon and breaking the curse of the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: You get this after killing Phantom Ganon, and thus breaking the curse 
 of the temple.

subject: Fire Medallion
text: The Fire Medallion is obtained after defeating Volvagia in the Fire Temple.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: You get this after dispatching Volvagia from the Fire Temple, and thus
 removing the ominous clouds hanging above Death Mountain and Kakariko Village.

subject: Water Medallion
text: Link receives the Water Medallion after killing Morpha.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: You get this after killing Morpha, the water creature that sucked Lake
 Hylia dry.

subject: Shadow Medallion
text: Link receives the Shadow Medallion after defeating the creature in the depths of the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: You get this after ridding the evil creature in the depths of the 
 Shadow Temple.

subject: Spirit Medallion
text: Link receives the Spirit Medallion upon defeating Twinrova and rescuing Nabooru at the Spirit Temple.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: You get this when you defeat Twinrova and rescue Nabooru at the Spirit
 Temple.

subject: Keaton Mask
text: The guard stationed by the Death Mountain Trail entrance in Kakariko Village wants the Keaton Mask.

evidence.quote: The guard by the Death Mountain Trail entrance in Kakariko Village wants this mask.

subject: Skull Mask
text: The Skull Kid to whom Link played Saria's Song wants the Skull Mask.

evidence.quote:
The Skull Kid who you played Saria's Song to wants this 
 mask.

subject: Spooky Mask
text: The child found in Kakariko Graveyard during the day wants the Spooky Mask.

evidence.quote:
The little kid seen in Kakariko Graveyard by the day wants this
 mask.

subject: Bunny Hood
text: The Running Man in Hyrule Field buys the Bunny Hood, which also prevents Stalchilds from attacking Link at night in Hyrule Field.

evidence.quote:
The Running Man in Hyrule Field wants this hood, and
 he's willing to sell it all for this hood. This will also keep Stalchilds from
 attacking you in Hyrule Field at night.

subject: Malon
text: Malon gives Link the Weird Egg at night on the Castle Grounds.

evidence.quote: Gotten: Malon gives it to you during night at the Castle Grounds.

subject: Chicken
text: The Weird Egg hatches into a Chicken when night turns to day.

evidence.quote: Gotten: The Weird Egg changes to this when night turns to day.

subject: Pocket Egg
text: The Cucco lady in Kakariko Village gives Adult Link the Pocket Egg and asks for it back once it hatches.

evidence.quote:
Given to you by the Cucco lady in Kakariko Village. 
 She wants it back when it's hatched.
